reviews.title: Good quality & Bang for the Buck
reviews.comment: For our Win 11 office needs this mb was fine. We paired it with an Intel i5-12400 cpu and 32GB RAM - DDR5.  It has multiple high speed M.2 slots (with included heat sinks) which negated the need for the older 2.5" SSD's.  Setup was easy But you Should update the BIOS and mb chipset.  Doing so required downloading software from their web site to a USB stick and plugging it into the pc.  It would have been nice to do if from the BIOS setup screen directly to their web site.  It even came with a user assembly booklet.  The web site .pdf is there too if you need to zoom in on something particular.
reviews.author: TDB

reviews.title: Working well with i7-12700 and its integrated GPU
reviews.comment: I ordered the Steel Legend Series for my first ever personal build (previously just bought laptops). Other than not realizing that I needed to run two power cables, it was plug and play. I have a modular power supply and when I saw the step that only had images for connecting power, it showed what looked like two ends of the same cable to me. When the first two problem LEDs came up red, I panicked and emailed ASRock for help, then figured it out the next day. Bluetooth is working with a gamepad. WiFi is working. DDR5 RAM and an m.2 SSD all came together nicely. I have been running Portal 2 fine without GPU, loads of other games in my Steam backlog will work fine with just the HD770 and an i7, so I will be set for a couple months till my budget recovers and I can buy a GPU. Will update if I run into any issues, but it's decent for me so far.

reviews.title: B760M Motherboard
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the ASRock B760M Steel Legend WiFi motherboard for my build, and honestly, it’s been great—easy 5 stars from me. Setup was super straightforward, and everything worked right out of the box without any issues. The layout is clean and made installing all my parts pretty easy, even in a smaller case. It also looks really nice in person. The white/silver design fits perfectly with my build, and it doesn’t feel cheap at all. Build quality is solid. Performance-wise, it’s been rock solid. No crashes, no weird bugs—just consistent and stable. The built-in WiFi works well too, which saved me from needing an extra adapter. It also has plenty of ports and features for what I need, so I don’t feel limited at all. Overall, it’s a really reliable motherboard that looks good and does everything I need without any problems. Definitely happy with it.
